subject: History
title: World War II: Causes, Course and Consequences
description: From the rise of fascism to the end of the war in 1945 and its effects on Africa.

questions.prompt: World War II began in Europe when Germany invaded which country in September 1939?
Which treaty, signed in 1919, was resented in Germany and is often seen as a cause of the war?
The policy of giving in to Hitler's demands in the 1930s, as at Munich in 1938, is called…
The United States entered the war after Japan attacked…
The Allied landing in Normandy on 6 June 1944 is known as…
The war in Europe ended with Germany's surrender in…
Atomic bombs were dropped on which two Japanese cities in August 1945?
Africans from the British and French colonies, including Cameroon, served in the war as…
options: Soldiers and labourers for the Allied armies
They did not take part at all

questions.prompt: Which international organisation was founded in 1945 to maintain world peace?
One major consequence of the war for Africa was…
options: The creation of the Berlin Conference
The return of German rule over Cameroon
The end of all trade with Europe
The growth of nationalist movements demanding independence
